title: Binance Introduces Soft Staking: Earn Staking Rewards from Your Spot Assets with Full Flexibility
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to introduce  Binance Soft Staking  - a new product that allows users to earn staking rewards on selected tokens from their Spot Accounts, which can be simply activated with one click. Soft Staking offers full flexibility—users can trade, withdraw, or use their tokens anytime while earning rewards on their spot assets. How Binance Soft Staking Works:  Soft Staking rewards are generated through the on-chain proof of stake mechanism and are paid out in the respective native token to users’ Spot Accounts daily. Rewards are calculated based on the daily average balance of eligible tokens in users’ Spot Accounts. Users can refer to the  Soft Staking Page  and  [ Staking History ]  under [Staking] > [Soft Staking] to check the reward records. Currently, tokens supported for Soft Staking include:  BNB, SOL, ADA, SUI, TON, NEAR, POL, ALGO, S, and AXS . To qualify for Soft Staking rewards, users must meet the respective minimum holding requirement for each token in their Spot balance. There is also a cap on the eligible holding amount. Any balance above this cap will not earn additional rewards. For more details, visit the  Soft Staking page . Benefits of Binance Soft Staking: Full Flexibility : No redemption process or lockup periods required. Withdraw or Trade Anytime:  Access and use your assets anytime without restrictions. Daily Rewards:  Receive daily rewards directly credited to your Spot Account. How to Get Started with Binance Soft Staking: Website Step 1: Navigate to the [ Earn ] section, select [Simple Earn] and click [ Soft Staking ]. Step 2: Click [Activate].  Step 3: Read and agree to the terms and click [Start Earning]. App Step 1: Tap on [More] on the App homepage. Step 2: Go to [Earn] > [Soft Staking]. Step 3: Click [Activate].  Step 4: Read and agree to the terms and click [Start Earning]. Activate Soft Staking Now More Information: Frequently Asked Questions on Binance Soft Staking Notes: Please refer to  Binance Soft Staking Terms ,  Binance Terms of Use  and the  Risk Warning  prior to using Binance Soft Staking. Users can view their soft staking amount and staking rewards by going to the  Soft Staking  page. Average daily snapshots of the Spot Account will start at 00:00 (UTC) on the day after the user activates Soft Staking. Staking rewards will be distributed to eligible users’ Spot Accounts on the next day after the snapshot (the second day after activation), between 00:00 and 08:00 (UTC).  U.S. persons, entities, and individuals from sanctioned countries will  not  be able to use Binance Soft Staking. Additionally, users may face access restrictions to Soft Staking due to prevailing product and/or regulatory limitations. For more information, please refer to  Binance Terms of Use . Disclaimer : By subscribing your Spot Account to Soft Staking, you acknowledge that the Eligible Soft Staked assets are no longer held in your Spot Account. Digital assets deployed in on-chain staking are subject to various risks. Binance's ability to return your Soft Staked Assets promptly may be adversely affected or delayed if a substantial number of Soft Staking Assets are withdrawn simultaneously, and the quantity of assets locked on-chain exceeds the available liquidity managed by Binance. There is no guaranteed timeframe for completing redemption or conversion requests. The Staking Rate is subject to change and may fluctuate from the rate applicable at the time of subscription. Digital asset prices can be volatile. You are solely responsible for your investment decisions, and Binance is not liable for any losses you may incur. The Annual Percentage Rate (APR) is an estimate of rewards you will earn in cryptocurrency over the selected timeframe. It does not represent actual or predicted returns/yield in any fiat currency. APR is adjusted daily, and estimated rewards may differ from actual rewards generated. This is not financial advice. For more information, please see our  Terms of Use  and  Risk Warning .
